_doc: Stems that contain a coordinator but are NOT double-barreled.
The double_barreled rule must fire on none of these.
A test set of obvious positives alone proves nothing: any implementation
that flags every coordinator would pass it, then produce a useless false
positive rate on real questionnaires. These hard negatives are the only
Both language versions are checked, so both must be non-triggering.

cases.why: 「您和家人」describes who the respondent was with, not two things being judged. Splitting changes the question: the item is about eating together.

stem.zh-CN: 您和家人一起用餐的频率是？
stem.en: How often do you eat out with your family?

cases.why: The coordinator joins the respondent to a companion; neither is an evaluation object.

stem.zh-CN: 您与朋友讨论过本产品吗？
stem.en: Have you discussed this product with friends?

cases.why: 「您和您的同事」is the subject of a single shared action, not two evaluated targets.

stem.zh-CN: 您和您的同事是否共用同一个账号？
stem.en: Do you and your colleagues share one account?

cases.why: 「质量和价格的比值」is one concept. Split it and one half stops meaning anything.

stem.zh-CN: 您如何评价质量和价格的比值？
stem.en: How would you rate the ratio between price and quality?

cases.why: The item asks about the relationship between the two, which is a single object of judgement.

stem.zh-CN: 您认为价格与质量之间的关系是否合理？
stem.en: Is the relationship between price and quality reasonable?

cases.why: Value for money is a single established construct.

stem.zh-CN: 请评价本产品的性价比。
stem.en: How would you rate the value for money?

cases.why: 「都」makes it one conjoined claim: have you used BOTH. Splitting changes the proposition.

stem.zh-CN: 线上和线下渠道您都使用过吗？
stem.en: Have you used both online and offline channels?

cases.why: Work and study are the setting, and 「都」asks whether both settings apply at once.

stem.zh-CN: 您在工作和学习场景中都会使用它吗？
stem.en: Do you use it both at work and while studying?

cases.why: 「同时」/ both asks about the joint consideration itself, which is one behaviour.

stem.zh-CN: 您购买时会同时考虑价格和质量吗？
stem.en: Do you consider both price and quality when buying?

cases.why: Control case: one evaluation object, no coordinator at all. Must never fire.

stem.zh-CN: 您平时更关注配送速度吗？
stem.en: Do you usually care more about delivery speed?
